data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: DSO_SPRINT_MODE eliminated from apply-attribution-trailers.sh (RED phase)
- DD3: 4-cell matrix cell 1 (ci-pr + sprint-active → inject trailer) covered for attribution
- DD5: TDD RED phase

## What to Change
Modify `tests/unit/scripts/test-apply-attribution-trailers.sh` to assert the NEW behavior:

The attribution guard currently uses `DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1` to bypass the `attribution.enabled` check.
New behavior: use `dso.workflow=ci-pr` AND `.sprint-active` file presence to determine sprint injection.

Add test functions:
1. **test_attribution_injects_in_ci_pr_sprint_mode**: Given `WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE` → `dso.workflow=ci-pr`, `.sprint-active` file present in REPO_ROOT — the trailer IS injected (attribution.enabled=false but sprint mode overrides)
2. **test_attribution_skips_when_local_workflow_sprint_active**: Given `dso.workflow=local`, `.sprint-active` present — the trailer is NOT injected (no-op, respects four-cell matrix cell 3)
3. **test_attribution_skips_when_no_sprint_marker**: Given `dso.workflow=ci-pr`, no `.sprint-active` — no injection (cell 2 no-op)

Remove: any test that sets `DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1` to trigger sprint behavior.
Preserve: existing tests for `read_and_deduplicate` and git-version guard (these test functions not related to sprint mode).

These tests MUST FAIL before Task 6 (apply-attribution-trailers.sh still reads DSO_SPRINT_MODE).

## Test Approach (Given / When / Then)
- **Given**: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=ci-pr fixture, REPO_ROOT with `.sprint-active`, attribution.enabled=false in config, valid JSONL attribution file
- **When**: bash apply-attribution-trailers.sh <commit-msg-file>
- **Then**: commit message file is modified to include trailer (exit 0, trailer present)

## .test-index RED Marker Requirement
Update `.test-index` for `plugins/dso/scripts/apply-attribution-trailers.sh`:
Add RED markers for new test function names.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — suite with RED markers
  Verify: bash -c 'grep -q "\[test_attribution_injects_in_ci_pr" .test-index && echo "RED marker present"'
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Test file contains dso.workflow-based test functions
  Verify: grep -q 'dso.workflow\|dso_workflow\|test_attribution_injects_in_ci_pr' tests/unit/scripts/test-apply-attribution-trailers.sh
- [ ] Test file no longer uses DSO_SPRINT_MODE to trigger sprint behavior
  Verify: ! grep -q 'DSO_SPRINT_MODE' tests/unit/scripts/test-apply-attribution-trailers.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers
  Verify: grep '\[test_attribution_injects_in_ci_pr' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: UPDATE test: assert apply-attribution-trailers.sh uses dso.workflow=ci-pr + .sprint-active instead of DSO_SPRINT_MODE
